g.text: Both cues act like doses: on conflicting scenes, landbirds go from 40% wrong at full size to 99% at scale 0.15; a
misleading word flips 95% of correctly classified landbirds once it is 4% tall
Faint lines = individual birds (ICE; mean over the 10 plates), bold = mean with 95% CI resampling species and plates. Left: bird pasted on gray / matching
/ conflicting plates. Right: word on the original image. The two columns use different base images; see 4f for a dose-matched comparison.
